<!-- pr-reviewer: ef83099b29d7bca512a786b84cb6b12f630e0f4f -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one process blocker: the issue reference).

Thanks, tbrasselle - the change itself looks clean.

**What looks good**
- Small, layered correctly (all in `crates/ui`, no app/flecs calls); `Gizmo.name` is filled in `gizmos()` so the Models-pane eye and `show_world_axes` gate carry over for free.
- No new `unwrap/expect/panic` outside tests (the ones in `law_tests.rs` are test code); no casts or indexing added; the origin projection is guarded by `project_uv`'s `Option`.
- No new toggle or state: labels are derived, so no command is needed. No icons, fonts, PNGs, dependencies, build.rs, scripts or .github files touched; no snapshot PNGs changed.
- Pins are named, the red-first story is documented, the decision file is in `docs/decisions/` (not RECOMMENDED.md), and there is no CHANGELOG.md edit. Clean-room: nothing derived from HSMWorks.

**Local results (merged with current upstream/main - already up to date, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test --lib` in `crates/ui` | 381 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The one failure is environmental (no GPU adapter on this review machine), not the PR:
```
egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds ... No suitable graphics adapter found
```
All gizmo_tests / axis_note_tests / setup_chip_tests passed.

**Requested before merge**
1. Wrong issue number. The title, body (`Fixes #641`), `Changelog:` line and `docs/decisions/641-viewport-gizmo-labels.md` all cite #641, but NeoTech/Camcraft #641 is "Lathe grooving/parting: blades post the centre of the width, but a blade is touched off on a corner - groove Z off by width/2" - unrelated. As written, merging would auto-close that open lathe bug. Please find (or file) the issue this really addresses, then fix the title, `Fixes #N`, the Changelog line, the decision file name/heading, and the `#641` mentions in the `interact.rs` comments. If there is no issue, use no closing keyword (e.g. `Refs`) and file one.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `interact.rs` (1781 lines) and `law_tests.rs` (2126 lines) were already far over the ~400-line guide; this adds ~35 and ~95 lines. Not blocking, but a split of the gizmo code later would help.
- The title says `feat(ui)`, so this ships at the next minor cut.
- The on-screen labels themselves were not visually checked here (nobody ran the GUI); the producers are pinned by tests.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: dfc87f09ea92aa8663e44a036ea53ddbbff02e55 -->
main does not build (#844); built and tested on PR + main + the pending #844 fix (mkinney 2c05183c).

**Needs changes before merge** (one test-coverage request from the maintainer, plus a body/changelog update for the new switch).

Re-review of head `dfc87f09` (earlier reviews at `ef83099b` and `f5181677`).

**Earlier findings**
- Wrong issue number (#641 -> #727): **resolved**. Title, `Fixes #727`, the Changelog line and the decision file (`docs/decisions/727-viewport-gizmo-labels.md`) all cite #727. The only remaining `#641` in the tree is in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_orientation_row.rs:4`, which is main's lathe work and not in this PR.
- Maintainer ask (names switchable, persisted, default on, both states tested): **implemented**. Checkbox "Show origin names" at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/browser_pane.rs:31`, default on at `crates/ui/src/state.rs` (`show_gizmo_names: true`), persisted via `crates/app/src/view.rs` (`view.json`, `camcraft-view/1`), read at startup in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs:202`. The switch gates only the name rows in `interact.rs` `overlay_labels`; letters and lines ignore it.

**What looks good**
- Layering holds: ui calls only `State` methods and `camcraft_app::view`; no sys_*/world calls from ui. The flip is view state, not a command, and the tests pin that (`pending` stays empty).
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in `view.rs`, `state_view.rs` or `browser_pane.rs`. A missing, corrupt or foreign file starts at the defaults and says why.
- Atomic write via `machine::store::write_atomic`; unknown keys tolerated.
- No snapshot PNGs, no build.rs/scripts/.github/Cargo changes, no process files touched (so no `PROCESS_VERSION` bump owed). Decision doc is in `docs/decisions/`, not RECOMMENDED.md.

**Local results** (trial merge with origin/main was textually clean; build failed only on the 7 `trochoid_slot.rs` errors of #844, so the #844 fix was merged into the throwaway tree)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 488 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test view_prefs` | 4 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: the other app suites (the PR touches `crates/app/src/lib.rs` and adds `view.rs` only, so the gate map is `view_prefs` plus the UI lib). No `--ignored` lanes, no snapshot tests, GUI not launched.

**Requested before merge**
1. The maintainer asked that "a structural test should cover both states". `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs:112` only adds "Show origin names" to the liveness list. The both-state assertions live in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/view_names.rs` (real clicks, file follows, restart) and `crates/ui/src/law_tests.rs` (`the_name_switch_quiets_names_not_letters_or_lines`). Please either add a both-states check to `structural.rs` (names present when on, absent when off; letters and lines present in both), or confirm with the maintainer that `view_names` is the structural test they meant.
2. The PR body still describes the pre-rework head. Its `Changelog:` line (line 25) and body never mention the "Show origin names" switch or the new `view.json` file. Please update the body and the Changelog line to say the names can be switched off and are remembered per user.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/interact.rs` is 1596 lines and `crates/ui/src/law_tests.rs` 2282 lines, both already over the ~400-line guide; this PR adds about 37 and 111 lines. A later split would help.
- The #727 decision claims the store writes where `CAMCRAFT_CONFIG_DIR` points, and the issue comment lists it as tested. `crates/app/tests/view_prefs.rs` has no test for that path (the four tests are round-trip, corrupt, unknown keys, default). Either add one or drop the claim.
- `Shell::new` now reads the real user's `view.json`. The UI harness uses `ShellUi::seeded()`, so tests stay hermetic, but a real `view.json` with names off would change what a live shell shows.
- Mergeability read as `UNKNOWN` on two reads; the trial merge was clean.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 91e36cb90aaf6555d49767c46d0edb842e3debc5 -->
**Needs changes before merge** (delta re-review of 91e36cb9; the PR also conflicts with current main on GitHub)

## Requested changes from the earlier review (dfc87f09)

1. **Structural both-states test - mostly resolved, one gap.** `structural::origin_names_paint_on_and_quiet_off_letters_and_lines_always` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs`, new at the end of the file) now asserts through the painted shell: the `G54` name row is in the viewport when on and gone when off (after a real click on "Show origin names"), and the axis letters and triad strokes are unchanged by the switch. That is a real assertion on painted text, not a field read. Still missing: the checkbox's own AccessKit state. The test clicks the checkbox but never asserts that its node reports checked/unchecked in each state. Add an assertion on the node's toggled state after the on/off steps, for example `h.get_by_label("Show origin names").accesskit_node().toggled()` checked against `st.show_gizmo_names`.
2. **PR body and Changelog - resolved.** The body now describes the switch, the ON default (#727 decision), storage in `view.json` (via `recent`'s resolver, so `CAMCRAFT_CONFIG_DIR` applies), and the Changelog line names it (#645). The closing keyword is `Fixes #727` only.

## Notes from the earlier review

- `CAMCRAFT_CONFIG_DIR`: the claim is now backed. `crates/app/tests/view_prefs.rs::the_config_dir_override_houses_the_view_file` drives `recent::config_dir_for` with a fake getter and round-trips the view file under the override. It passes.
- No snapshot PNG changed (`crates/ui/tests/snapshots` untouched against main). Nothing new outside `crates/ui`, the view prefs in `crates/app`, and `docs/decisions/727-viewport-gizmo-labels.md`.
- Still open from the notes, not blocking: `interact.rs` and `law_tests.rs` remain far over the 400-line guide.

## Blocker: conflicts with main

GitHub reports `mergeable: CONFLICTING`. A trial merge with `origin/main` (6458433f) conflicts in code, so I reviewed the head without merging:
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs`: main moved the `Shell` impl (the window and GPU code) out of this file; the PR still edits it (the `load_view` call in `Shell::new`). Both sides need to be carried into the new home.
- `crates/ui/src/interact.rs`: overlapping gizmo-label hunks.
Please merge main into the branch and keep both sides. Nothing is lost by the merge.

## Local results (PR head 91e36cb9, not merged with main)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 490 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `structural::origin_names_paint_on_and_quiet_off_letters_and_lines_always` | 1 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test view_prefs` | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not built on the merged tree (the merge conflicts). Snapshot tests not run, as per the release-lane rule.

## Requested before merge

1. Add the checkbox's AccessKit checked/unchecked assertion in both states to the structural test (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs`, around the `Show origin names` click).
2. Merge `origin/main` into `issue/641-viewport-gizmo-labels`, resolving `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs` and `crates/ui/src/interact.rs` by keeping both sides, then re-run the targeted tests.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 29112f6fc1b87375543878fcf23d2516b9f8c289 -->
**Delta review of 29112f6f (merge of main only): the merge is sound. Needs changes before merge: one request from the last review is still owed.**

**Merge verdict, per conflicted file**
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs`: the PR's only edit here was one line, `state.load_view();` after `load_recent()` in `Shell::new`. Main moved that impl to `shell_window.rs` (line 147 at the head). The line landed there, once, and is not duplicated. The rest of the file is main's. OK.
- `crates/ui/src/interact.rs`: both sides survive. The PR's `Gizmo.name`, `WORLD_LABEL`, `NAME_DROP_UV`, the origin-name emission gated on `state.show_gizmo_names`, and main's `AXES_LIGHT` / `axes()` light-ground inks are all present. The origin-name colour uses `axes()[2].0`, so it follows the light ground.
- Other files: the merge is clean (`git diff --stat` on snapshots is empty). `browser_pane.rs:32-37` still wires "Show origin names" through `set_gizmo_names`.

**Note (not a blocker):** the world-origin name is drawn in neutral gray `WORLD_GRAY * WORLD_DIM` (about 0.6) in `interact.rs` (around line 668). It is not light-aware, unlike the offset names. On the light ground it should still read, but it is low contrast. Consider `axes()`-style lifting or a `ground_ink` token.

**Still owed (request 1 from the last review, not addressed by a merge-only push)**
`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs:324` (`origin_names_paint_on_and_quiet_off_letters_and_lines_always`) asserts the painted names and the `show_gizmo_names` flag in both states. It never asserts the "Show origin names" checkbox's own AccessKit checked state, on or off. Add a checked-state assertion for that checkbox in both states, next to the existing `get_by_label("Show origin names").click()` at line 370.

**Local results (PR head merged with origin/main 759f6dee, trial merge clean)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`): 522 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test view_prefs`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: exit 0.
- No snapshot PNG changed on the PR side or in the merge.

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs` near line 370: assert the "Show origin names" checkbox's AccessKit checked state is on in the default state and off after the click.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 0f21a4cd8803f31cc2667978b5ea1e1db5ee94bd -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one blocker: a new test fails on the tree that results from merging current `main`).

Re-review of head `0f21a4cd`, after `29112f6f` (main merge only). The earlier checkbox blocker is resolved.

**Earlier blocker: checkbox AccessKit state - resolved.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs:353` asserts `toggled() == Some(True)` in the default state, and `:381` asserts `Some(False)` after the click. Both states are covered, so the request from the last review is met.

**Toggle path - OK.** "Show origin names" (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/browser_pane.rs:33`) calls `State::set_gizmo_names` (`crates/ui/src/state_view.rs:44`), which is view state persisted through `camcraft_app::view`. It is not a command and it is not on the history. This matches the existing "Show world origin axes" and "Show all toolpaths" toggles, which are also view state. The `pending` list stays empty in the law test, so it is pinned. Not blocking.

**Blocker: the new structural test fails after the merge with `main`.**
- `main` changed the dock tab titles to capitalised ("Browser", "Viewport", "Properties"; `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/mod.rs:172`, and `tests/structural.rs:84` on main).
- The PR's new test still looks up the lower-case labels: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs:339` (`at(&texts, "viewport")`) and `:340` (`at(&texts, "properties")`).
- Result on the trial merge: `origin_names_paint_on_and_quiet_off_letters_and_lines_always` panics with `no painted text "viewport"`.
- Fix: use `"Viewport"` and `"Properties"` at those two lines. I checked this locally with a temporary edit, reverted afterwards: the test then passes. Please push the fix, then merge main again if it moves.

**Local results** (trial merge with `origin/main` is textually clean; GitHub reports MERGEABLE)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 535 passed, 1 failed (the structural test above), 5 ignored |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test view_prefs` | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

```
---- egui_app::tests::structural::origin_names_paint_on_and_quiet_off_letters_and_lines_always stdout ----
panicked at crates\ui\src\egui_app\tests\structural.rs:47:17:
no painted text "viewport"; painted: ["New", "Model", ..., "Browser", ..., "Viewport", "Properties", ...]
```

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs:339-340`: change `"viewport"` to `"Viewport"` and `"properties"` to `"Properties"` to match main's tab titles. Then re-run `origin_names_paint_on_and_quiet_off_letters_and_lines_always` on the merged tree.

**Notes (non-blocking)**
- File sizes on the merged tree: `crates/ui/src/interact.rs` 1685 -> 1723 lines (main's count) and `crates/ui/src/law_tests.rs` 2282 -> 2309 lines. Both were already well over the ~400-line guide. Growth noted, not blocking.
- Carried from the last review, not re-checked here: the world-origin name is neutral grey and not light-aware, so it may be low contrast on main's light ground. Nobody ran the GUI.
- `State::set_gizmo_names` discards the `view::save` result with `let _ =`. `view::save` logs the failure through `tracing::warn!`, so it is not silent. Fine as is.
- No snapshot PNG changed, no `eprintln!`/`println!` in the shared UI code (the two `eprintln!` calls were moved to `diag_warn!` in `1c8583f2` and `0f21a4cd`), no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` added outside tests, and the layering stays ui -> app. The PR adds `docs/decisions/727-viewport-gizmo-labels.md`, and no CHANGELOG.md edit or process file is touched.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
